entities.summary: The Kursum Mosque is a historical Ottoman-era mosque in the town of Kastoria, Western Macedonia, Greece. The mosque is located close to the old centre of town, on Mitropoleos Street. Like most mosques in Greece, it has not been operational since the 1920s, and is currently in a poor state of preservation.
